title: the whole, and a page for each place ({count})
query: SELECT path, looks, scale, of_thing, says, title FROM (SELECT 'index.html' AS path, 'front' AS looks, 'every place observed' AS scale, '' AS of_thing, 'the whole: what followed the latest thing the author said, this observatory''s sheet, the perfect form, and every lens over every place in view' AS says, coalesce((SELECT max(says) FROM things WHERE of_table = 'places' AND star = 'marshall-oco.github.io'), 'The fulldome') AS title UNION ALL SELECT 'places/' || place || '.html', 'around@' || id, 'a place', id, coalesce(says, ''), star FROM things WHERE of_table = 'places') ORDER BY path

title: a page for each sign ({count})
query: SELECT 'signs/' || place || '/' || substr(id, length(place) + length(of_table) + 3) || '.html' AS path, 'around@' || id AS looks, star AS scale, id AS of_thing, star, coalesce(says, '') AS says, 'A sign' AS title FROM things WHERE of_table = 'problems' ORDER BY path

title: a page for each angle of the perfect form ({count})
query: SELECT 'form/' || substr(t.id, length(t.place) + length(t.of_table) + 3) || '.html' AS path, 'around@' || t.id AS looks, 'an angle of the perfect form' AS scale, t.id AS of_thing, coalesce(t.says, '') AS says, i.heading AS title FROM things t JOIN idea i ON i.star = t.star AND i.id = substr(t.id, length(t.place) + length(t.of_table) + 3) WHERE t.of_table = 'idea' AND t.star = 'ecosystem' ORDER BY path

title: a page for each decision a sign came to ({count})
query: SELECT 'decisions/' || t.place || '/' || substr(t.id, length(t.place) + length(t.of_table) + 3) || '.html' AS path, 'around@' || t.id AS looks, t.star AS scale, t.id AS of_thing, t.star, coalesce(t.says, '') AS says, 'A decision' AS title FROM things t WHERE t.of_table = 'decisions' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edges e WHERE e."to" = t.id AND e.from_table = 'problems') ORDER BY path

title: a page for each record of work of late, and each thing it entered or changed ({count})
query:
WITH late AS (
  SELECT g.star, g.id FROM glimpses g
  WHERE try_cast(left(CAST(g."at" AS VARCHAR), 10) AS DATE) >= DATE '{today}' - INTERVAL 2 DAY
), shown AS (
  SELECT t.id FROM things t JOIN late l ON t.of_table = 'glimpses' AND t.star = l.star AND t.id = t.place || '/glimpses:' || l.id
  UNION
  SELECT e."to" FROM edges e JOIN late l ON e.from_table = 'glimpses' AND e.from_star = l.star AND e.from_id = l.id
  WHERE e.how = 'touches' AND e.holds
), paged AS (
  SELECT t.*, substr(t.id, length(t.place) + length(t.of_table) + 3) AS own FROM things t JOIN shown s ON s.id = t.id
)
SELECT 'things/' || place || '/' || of_table || '/' || own || '.html' AS path, 'around@' || id AS looks, star AS scale,
       id AS of_thing, star, coalesce(says, '') AS says,
       CASE WHEN of_table = 'glimpses' THEN 'a record of work'
            ELSE coalesce((SELECT min(le.entry) FROM lens_entries le WHERE le.fills = paged.of_table), of_table) END AS title
FROM paged
WHERE of_table NOT IN ('problems', 'places', 'turns')
  AND NOT (of_table = 'idea' AND star = 'ecosystem')
  AND NOT (of_table = 'decisions' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edges e WHERE e."to" = paged.id AND e.from_table = 'problems'))
  AND regexp_matches(own, '^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$') AND NOT contains(own, '..')
ORDER BY path
